independentCalculation:
Independent 50-digit Decimal simple discounted LCOE specialization.
Year-zero CAPEX + discounted constant end-of-year OPEX divided by discounted
first-year delivered kWh with geometric degradation. Currency and rate basis
are explicit labels; no taxes, debt, escalation, replacement or salvage schedules.
SAM LCOE help documents discounted costs/energy and real vs nominal distinction;
this is NOT parity with SAM's full tax/debt cashflow. Synthetic costs/rates are
arithmetic cases, not product or jurisdiction assumptions. No TS imports/output.

referenceSource.title: SAM LCOE discounted costs/delivered energy; independent Decimal simple pre-tax specialization
referenceSource.locator: Levelized Cost of Energy Equations and Real and Nominal LCOE; simple constant-OPEX unlevered specialization, NOT full SAM taxes/debt implementation.

limitations: Pre-tax unlevered screen: constant annual OPEX, first-year energy under the declared basis with geometric degradation; no taxes, debt, escalation, replacement or salvage schedules.
Numerical arithmetic verification is not validation of project assumptions or financial eligibility.
Energy delivery boundary is not established; generation-proxy or unspecified energy is not an assessed delivered-cost basis.
